FIELDS.NAME: Stationery Haven
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Stationery Haven, we operate a retail business specializing in a wide range of stationery and paper products. Our offerings include writing supplies, notebooks, planners, art supplies, and various office essentials. With a focus on quality and customer service, our storefront is designed to provide a welcoming shopping experience, complemented by a user-friendly online platform that allows customers to browse and purchase our products conveniently. We prioritize sourcing our items from reputable suppliers and ensure adherence to safety and labeling standards. Our dedicated team maintains an organized inventory system and participates in regular stock audits to minimize loss and ensure product availability. We also engage with the local community through educational events and workshops aimed at promoting creative expression and sustainability practices.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Online stationery supply store specializing in eco-friendly products.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Loss on 03/02/2023 due to theft of stationery products valued at $800. Case reported to local authorities and currently under investigation. Losses have been accounted for in inventory management system.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 9 AM - 6 PM, Saturday: 10 AM - 5 PM, Closed on Sunday
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Fire-rated safe, Class B, labeled for secure storage of documents and cash.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Regular on-site security patrols and a monitored alarm system.

reviews: I love shopping here! They have such a diverse selection of stationery products, and I was pleasantly surprised to find unique imports from overseas that I haven’t seen anywhere else. It's great to find such variety in one place!
The staff is incredibly helpful and knowledgeable. They helped me pick out the perfect planner for my needs.
I love the eco-friendly options they offer! It's great to see a stationery store that cares about the environment.
The prices are reasonable, and the quality of the products is top-notch. I'll definitely be coming back!
Their online shopping experience is seamless, and my order arrived quickly. Highly recommend!
